digest.component_or_area: contributor guidance and agent operational documentation
propositions: Contributors and agents must fast-forward their own worktree (not the shared main checkout) after a Gerrit merge and before closing a ticket to ensure the merged commit is reachable from HEAD for the close precheck.

The close completion verifier (_referencing_commit_exists) runs git log over repo_root with ref=HEAD to confirm the rebar-ticket commit is reachable; a stale worktree HEAD fails this check and blocks close with 'cannot confirm the work landed'.
AGENTS.md must document post-merge fast-forward discipline in the Git workflow section with explicit warning never to touch the shared main checkout.
CONTRIBUTING.md must add a new §2f subsection after §2e (Submit) covering post-merge worktree fast-forward and close-from-worktree workflow with the same shared-checkout safety guidance.
